glosses: a set or selection of something
a group of trees forming a grove

examples.text: Je donnerai un bouquet de fleurs à ma petite-amie.
examples.en: I will give a bunch of flowers to my girlfriend.

examples.text: Au sommet, il y avait un bouquet d'arbres.
examples.en: At the top, there was a clump of trees.

examples.text: Tom est sorti en douce et a subrepticement acheté un gros bouquet de fleurs à Mary pour leur anniversaire de mariage.
examples.en: Tom snuck out and surreptitiously bought Mary a big bunch of flowers for their wedding anniversary.
